# Ọṣun, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Ọṣun**'s was unusually clear.

Ọṣun's stories are told in Ifá verses, river rituals, and the annual Oshogbo festival. They centre on the power of sweetness, the necessity of women's wisdom, and the river as a living goddess.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **7 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ọṣun
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Love, Freshwater, Fertility
- **Pattern seats:** 7
- **Sectors touched:** Home & Lifestyle · Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Health & Wellbeing · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Beauty, Fashion & Cosmetics
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 183 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Ọṣun and the Failed World.** When the male orishas set out to create the world, they ignored Ọṣun.  Their work collapsed: what they built fell apart, what they planted withered, and what they decided proved unjust. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Òṣun River and Oshogbo.** The city of Oshogbo was founded where Ọṣun appeared to a hunter and the first king, establishing the sacred grove that is now a UNESCO World Heritage site.  The river is not merely her symbol; it is believed to be her body. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Beauty, Fashion & Cosmetics

*Cosmetics, fashion, and personal care. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*Beauty, sweetness, and adornment; the river that gilds.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Love, Dating & Relationships

*Dating apps, relationship services, and romance. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*The sweet river of love; attraction as fresh water.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Freshwater & Hydrology

*Water supply, irrigation, and watershed management. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The sweet river itself; freshwater as love, fertility, and livelihood.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Freshwater fertility; the river that sweetens the crop.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Her festivals still draw rivers of devotees.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

The temple holds 2 further seats beyond these — the full, argued list lives on its [patterns floor](/sites/oshun/patterns/).

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Ọṣun's stories are told in Ifá verses, river rituals, and the annual Oshogbo festival. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in beauty, fashion & cosmetics, love, dating & relationships, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/oshun/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
